# mgcl Provider

The mgcl provider reads and writes bootstrap secrets through a `mgcl run -- <command>` provider session. Connection details are read from `MGCL_PROVIDER_ENDPOINT` and `MGCL_PROVIDER_TOKEN`; the provider has no HCL arguments. Requires OpenTofu >= 1.11 for ephemeral resources. The `mgcl_secret` ephemeral resource keeps values out of plan and state. The `provider::mgcl::secret_value` function reads only KVs marked public; its result is ordinary string or map data that OpenTofu may persist in plan, state and logs. The `provider::mgcl::i_just_fucking_wanna_read_ephemeral` function reads public and ephemeral KVs; its result is also ordinary string or map data that OpenTofu may persist, and the function name does not grant OpenTofu ephemeral semantics. The `mgcl_secret` managed resource owns a set of KVs in one Secret; their values are always stored in plan and state, and `Sensitive` only hides them from CLI output. The `mgcl_secret_kv` managed resource writes one KV; its value is always stored in plan and state, and `Sensitive` only hides it from CLI output.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    mgcl = {
      source = "geektr-cloud/mgcl"
    }
  }
}

# The provider has no HCL arguments. MGCL_PROVIDER_ENDPOINT and
# MGCL_PROVIDER_TOKEN are injected by `mgcl run -- <command>`.
provider "mgcl" {}
```
